title: Nursery Rhymes
text:
Nursery rhymes are short songs for children. Many people know the song 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star'. It is about a small star in the sky. Children like to sing it with their parents.

Another famous rhyme is 'Baa, Baa, Black Sheep'. In the song, a sheep gives wool to the children. Nursery rhymes are easy to learn. Children sing them at school and at home.

questions.text: What is the song 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star' about?
options: A small star in the sky
A big dog in the park
A red car on the road
A cold river in the city

questions.text: What does the sheep give to the children in the song 'Baa, Baa, Black Sheep'?
Why do children probably enjoy nursery rhymes?
options: The rhymes are easy to learn and fun to sing
The rhymes are very long and hard to remember
The rhymes are only for adults
The rhymes are difficult to read

questions.text: Where do children probably sing nursery rhymes?
options: In the middle of the sea

paragraph_translations: Las rimas infantiles son canciones cortas para niños. Muchas personas conocen la canción 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star'. Trata de una pequeña estrella en el cielo. A los niños les gusta cantarla con sus padres.
Otra rima famosa es 'Baa, Baa, Black Sheep'. En la canción, una oveja da lana a los niños. Las rimas infantiles son fáciles de aprender. Los niños las cantan en la escuela y en casa.
